What is included & how this is calculated

The normal Full model combines 10 price components and three lower-only Bedrock models. Full V2 uses 22 rarity price components, excluding the LTH realized, capitalized, and BTC/USD median prices. STH versions, Awake, and Coinflow remain included. Normal Full keeps its original LTH components. The three Bedrock floors remain included. For each low percentile, the highest component boundary wins; for each high percentile, the lowest wins. P10–P90 are interpolated logarithmically between P5 and P95.

These are daily closing snapshots of the backend’s block-based rarity calculations, not newly calculated daily-history percentiles. Both panels use the same dates and vertical scale. Hover for values and the components setting P5/P95. If bands cross, Full V2 preserves the crossing rather than reordering them. Today’s incomplete candle is excluded.

• Already in normal Full   + Additional price component. Raw, cointime, and coinflow Bedrock floors are included in both.
